stem: In observational data, customers who chose express delivery have a higher repeat rate than others, both on desktop and on mobile. A colleague says: "Splitting by device settles it: express delivery causes repeat purchases." Why is caution needed?

options.text: Splitting by one segment removes every other difference between the groups
Differences other than device can still drive the result
Segment results are never valid; only the combined number counts
Express delivery must lower repeat purchases, since it costs more
